subject: [RFC PATCH 11/57] mm/collapse: sketch the passes of a round

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new concept called 'rounds' in the collapse mechanism, which is a sequence of passes over the same batch. A round consists of three parts: before any lock, under mmap_read, and from freeze onwards. The patch lays out this sequence with stub passes for each part, including a fault-in pass that may have to sleep and drop the lock. If a fault has to wait, it is reported as SCAN_LOCK_DROPPED and the round takes the lock again and runs the pass afresh a bounded number of times.
